summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K reporting that its operating partnership, FNLR OP LP, exercised a second extension option under its August 13, 2024 Credit Agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent. The extension moves the maturity of the term loan and revolving credit facilities from October 16, 2026 to October 15, 2027. The filing is a routine credit-facility amendment under Items 1.01 and 2.03, signed by CFO Avraham Dreyfuss. No special-situation transaction, pricing, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is implicated; watch covenant headroom and refinancing risk at the new 2027 maturity.
